question: Which political party was in power in England when the Cabinet Mission came to India? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (30/01/2021) Shift 1)
options: Liberal Party
Democratic Party
Conservative Party
Labour Party
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Labour Party

Explanation:
When the Cabinet Mission came to India in 1946, the Labour Party was in power in England, with Clement Attlee as Prime Minister. The mission consisted of three members: Lord Pethick-Lawrence, Sir Stafford Cripps, and A.V. Alexander. Its purpose was to devise a plan for the formation of a Constituent Assembly and the transfer of power in India.

☛ Who were the three members of the Cabinet Mission? → Lord Pethick-Lawrence, Sir Stafford Cripps, A.V. Alexander
☛ What was the objective of the Cabinet Mission? → To plan the formation of the Constituent Assembly in India
☛ What step did the Labour Party take regarding Indian independence? → Passed the Indian Independence Act 1947
☛ What was the proposal of provincial groups in the Cabinet Mission Plan? → Suggestion to create three groups (A, B, C)

question: The Integrated Child Protection Scheme was launched in the year: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (30/01/2021) Shift 2)
options: 2011-2012
2015-2016
2016-2017
2009-2010
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 2009-2010

Explanation:
The Integrated Child Protection Scheme (ICPS) was launched by the Government of India in 2009-2010. It aims to provide protection and rehabilitation to children in difficult circumstances. The scheme is under the Ministry of Women and Child Development and includes strengthening of child care institutions, adoption, and the juvenile justice system. It helps implement the provisions of the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2000. Under ICPS, financial assistance is given to state governments to protect children's rights. The scheme also contributes to preventing child trafficking and child labour.

☛ Which ministry administers ICPS? → Ministry of Women and Child Development
☛ What is the main objective of ICPS? → To provide protection and rehabilitation to children
☛ Which act does ICPS help implement? → Juvenile Justice Act, 2000
☛ What are the provisions under ICPS? → Child care institutions, adoption, juvenile justice system

question: PAHAL Scheme is related with: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (30/01/2021) Shift 2)
options: Agricultural credit
Direct transfer of LPG subsidy
Child welfare scheme
Women education
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Direct transfer of LPG subsidy

Explanation:
The PAHAL scheme (Pratyaksh Hastantarit Labh) is a flagship initiative of the Government of India that involves direct transfer of LPG subsidy to consumers. Under this scheme, the subsidy amount is directly credited to the bank accounts of eligible LPG consumers, eliminating intermediaries and enhancing transparency. It was implemented nationwide in 2014 and aims to prevent misuse and diversion of subsidized LPG cylinders. The scheme is also known as DBTL (Direct Benefit Transfer for LPG). It helped the government remove millions of fake connections, leading to significant savings. This scheme is a key example of direct benefit transfer in the energy sector.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ PAHAL scheme relates to? → Direct transfer of LPG subsidy
☛ Full name of PAHAL scheme? → Pratyaksh Hastantarit Labh
☛ When was PAHAL scheme launched? → 2014
☛ PAHAL scheme is also known as? → DBTL (Direct Benefit Transfer for LPG)
☛ How is subsidy transferred under PAHAL? → Directly to bank accounts

question: Which Abhiyan was launched in 2014 on the birth anniversary of the Father of the Nation? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (31/01/2021) Shift 2)
options: Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi
Saansad Adarsh Gram Yojana

This initiative promoted sanitation and public health, leading to increased toilet construction and hygiene awareness across the country.

question: Which of the following is NOT a UN Agenda for Sustainable Development 2030? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (01/02/2021) Shift 1)
options: Reduce the total population of the world by \(\frac{1}{3}\)rd
Achieve food security by 2030
End poverty in all its forms everywhere
Reduce inequality within and among nations
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Reduce the total population of the world by 1/3rd

Explanation:
The United Nations 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, adopted in 2015 by all UN member states, sets out 17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). These goals focus on ending poverty, achieving food security, reducing inequality, climate action, and peace. There is no goal related to reducing population. Option 1, 'Reduce the total population of the world by 1/3rd', is not part of any SDG. The other three options correspond to SDG 2 (ending hunger), SDG 1 (ending poverty), and SDG 10 (reducing inequality), respectively. Hence, this option is not part of the UN Agenda for Sustainable Development 2030.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Total number of UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) → 17
☛ Objective of SDG 2 → End hunger and achieve food security by 2030
☛ Objective of SDG 10 → Reduce inequality within and among countries
☛ Objective of SDG 1 → End poverty in all its forms everywhere
☛ When did the 2030 Agenda come into effect → 1 January 2016

question: In which of the following years did the Government of India initiate the National Programme of Nutritional Support to Primary Education (NP-NSPE) (RRB NTPC CBT-I (01/02/2021) Shift 2)
options: 1990
1995
2003
1985
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1995

Explanation:
The Government of India initiated the National Programme of Nutritional Support to Primary Education (NP-NSPE) in the year 1995. This programme later came to be known as the Mid-Day Meal Scheme. Its objective was to provide nutritional support to children studying in primary schools and to increase enrollment and attendance. The scheme was implemented in all government and government-aided primary schools across the country. NP-NSPE is administered by the Ministry of Human Resource Development (now Ministry of Education). This programme has been instrumental in reducing malnutrition among children and improving the level of primary education.

question: Which of the following is CORRECT statement for Kishor category under Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (02/02/2021) Shift 2)

Loan to small business from 75 thousand up to 15 lakhs
Loan to small businessmen from 25 thousand up to 5 lakhs
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Loan to small businessmen from 50 thousand up to 5 lakhs

Explanation:
Under the Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY), there are three categories: Shishu (0-50,000 rupees), Kishor (50,000-5 lakh rupees), and Tarun (5-10 lakh rupees). The Kishor category provides loans from 50 thousand to 5 lakh rupees to small businessmen. This scheme was launched in 2015 to provide financial support to non-corporate, non-farm small enterprises. Its objective is to promote self-employment and entrepreneurship. The Kishor category is for businesses that are slightly more established and require higher capital. The interest rate is market-based, and no subsidy is provided. The scheme is implemented through banks, NBFCs, and microfinance institutions.

question: Name the state government that announced its decision to ban production, distribution, advertisement and sale of e-cigarette within its territory in May 2019? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (03/02/2021) Shift 1)

question: The main aim of the 'Ganga Action Plan’ is: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (03/02/2021) Shift 2)
options: Efficient use of Ganga water for drinking purpose
Reduction of pollution in Ganga river
Efficient use of Ganga water for irrigation
Using Ganga river for generating hydel energy
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Reduction of pollution in Ganga river

Explanation:
The Ganga Action Plan (GAP) was launched in 1985 with the primary objective of reducing pollution in the Ganga river and improving its water quality. It was implemented by the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB). The plan focused on treating industrial and domestic wastewater that was being discharged into the river. Under Phase I (GAP-I), sewage treatment plants were established in cities across Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, and West Bengal. Phase II (GAP-II) included additional towns. Although the plan achieved limited success, it paved the way for more comprehensive initiatives like Namami Gange.

question: Which of the following programs provides state-of-the-art central assistance to basic services such as primary health, primary education, rural shelter, rural drinking water and rural electrification?   (RPF Constable 2018 (08/02/2019) Shift 2)
options: Swarnjayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana (SGSY)
Prime Minister Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
Prime Minister Gramodaya Yojana (PMGY)

solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Prime Minister Gramodaya Yojana (PMGY)

Explanation:
Prime Minister Gramodaya Yojana (PMGY) was launched in 2000-01. This scheme provides additional resources to states to improve these services. Among other options, SGSY is related to self-employment, PMJDY to financial inclusion, and AAY to food security. question: Which Ministry of Indian Government launched the "Startup India Scheme"? (RPF Constable 2018 (09/02/2019) Shift 2)
options: Ministry of Finance
Ministry of Rural Development
Ministry of Commerce & Industry
Ministry of Agriculture
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Ministry of Commerce & Industry

The scheme has strengthened the 'Atmanirbhar Bharat' campaign and positioned India as a global startup hub.
